speech_recognition._comment_streaming_asr_model: Optional: name of a bundled ASR model directory under assets/. Bundling pre-installs the model so the user skips the first-run download. Set to null or omit the field to require in-app download.

tts._comment_model: Optional: name of a bundled TTS model directory under assets/. Same trade-off as ASR — bundling is a convenience shortcut, not a requirement. Set to null or omit to require in-app download.
